content: Spotlighting (Microsoft, arXiv 2403.14720) = family of indirect-injection defenses making provenance salient: delimiting (wrap tool output in delimiters, instruct model to ignore instructions inside), data-marking (interleave a marker token e.g. 5-gram #$_^% through untrusted text so model can distinguish data from instructions), encoding (base64 etc for high-capacity models). Reduces attack success >50% -> <2% with minimal task-efficacy loss. RAG amplifies attack surface by auto-inserting retrieved content. OWASP: clearly denote untrusted content + semantic filters scanning for non-allowed content. DataFilter/classifier approaches add a detection pass. No single defense is complete; layering is the honest bar.
